tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this subchapter—

children.text: $60,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2018 through 2024; and
$60,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2028.

tree.heading: Availability
tree.text: Funds appropriated under subsection (a) shall remain available until expended.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 17617 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2025—Subsec. (a)(11). Pub. L. 119–60 added par. (11). 2022—Subsec. (a)(10). Pub. L. 117–262 substituted “2024” for “2022”. 2017—Subsec. (a)(10). Pub. L. 115–82 substituted “each of fiscal years 2018 through 2022” for “fiscal year 2018”. 2012—Subsec. (a)(6) to (10). Pub. L. 112–206 added pars. (6) to (10).
